nurse.text: Croeso! Welcome to the Sanctuary. Kettle's on. It's always on. We're in Wales.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Hand over your team. We'll have them fit for the mountain in a tick.
All better! Mind the stairs, a goat got in last week and left opinions.
The Ark terminal's by the radiator. Keep your fingers clear of the hard drive.

else.text: No bother. Shout if anyone needs a cuppa or a blister plaster.
